grouping: CROSS-CUTTING: tasks grouped by affected feature — search (new), authentication (additive SessionRepository.list_all), user-management (additive source), file-management (additive source), session-management (additive source), plus the final cross-cutting startup-wiring/contract task

tasks.title: search foundation: package layout, models (source/query/result), SearchError hierarchy, events, SearchService registration lifecycle + single-source query entry point (free text), InMemorySource, module singleton
implementation_steps: Create the src/backend/search/ package per the spec's package layout: __init__.py (public API re-exports), models.py, errors.py, events.py, service.py (ADR-076)

Implement models.py: FieldType (closed set string/number/boolean/datetime), SourceField (name matching FIELD_NAME_PATTERN, type, searchable/filterable/sortable/display flags), SourceItem (item_id, fields), SourcePage (items, total), SourceQueryContext (free_text, filters, offset, limit, sort), SearchSource (name matching SOURCE_NAME_PATTERN, fields, sync query function), FilterOperator (equals/contains/starts_with/gt/gte/lt/lte/in_list/is_null), FilterCondition (field, operator, value), FilterGroup (and/or, nestable conditions), Sort (field, direction), SearchQuery (free_text, filters, feature, offset, limit, sort), SearchResultItem (feature, item_id, fields), SourceFailure (feature, reason, error), SearchResult (items, total, offset, limit, failures) (REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-004, REQ-006, REQ-008, REQ-009)

Implement errors.py: the domain SearchError hierarchy (NOT ValueError) — SearchError base, UnknownSourceError (source), MalformedQueryError (reason, field, source), SourceQueryFailedError (source, reason, error) (REQ-010)
Implement events.py: SourceRegistered (source), SourceUnregistered (source), SourceQueryFailed (source, reason) — non-sensitive data only — and the structural EventPublisher protocol (REQ-014)

Implement service.py SearchService(event_bus=None, settings_registry=None, permission_service=None): constructor DI; a None event_bus means no events and no error; a None settings_registry uses the shared get_settings_registry(); a None permission_service is standalone mode (no enforcement) (REQ-004, REQ-016, ADR-079)

Implement the registration lifecycle: register_source(source) — re-registration with the same name replaces atomically (SourceRegistered published); identical re-registration (same name + equal fields + same query function) is an idempotent no-op (no event); an invalid declaration (name/field name not matching the patterns, duplicate field names, unknown field type) raises ValueError (argument-level) (REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-003, ADR-077)
Implement unregister_source(name) — unknown name is a no-op (no event); SourceUnregistered published on removal (REQ-003)
Implement list_sources() -> list[str] in registration order, and reset() clearing all registrations (no events) (REQ-001, REQ-003)

Implement the single-source query entry point search(query, principal=Principal()): resolve the feature (unknown -> UnknownSourceError); normalize the free text (case-folded + NFC + trimmed; empty/None = no constraint); call the source's query function; map the SourcePage to a SearchResult (items = SearchResultItem(feature, item_id, fields), total, offset, limit) (REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-009, REQ-010, REQ-012)

Implement InMemorySource(name, fields, items): a public in-memory source for tests/DI; default ordering = insertion order; the query function applies free text, filters, sort, and pagination in memory with the spec's normalization and per-type semantics (REQ-017, ADR-077)

Implement get_search_service(event_bus=None, settings_registry=None, permission_service=None) -> SearchService (module singleton; first call creates, later calls return it) and reset_search_service() clearing the singleton (REQ-017)
Guard the registry with an internal lock: register/unregister/reset take the lock; search snapshots the registrations under the lock and queries outside it (REQ-018)
Export the public API from __init__.py (the NFR-003 contract: SearchService, InMemorySource, the models, the errors, the events, EventPublisher, get_search_service, reset_search_service)
design_constraints: The registry is in-memory only — no index, no persistence (stateless live query) (REQ-001, ADR-078)
The field-type set is closed (string/number/boolean/datetime) — a list field is not representable and not exposed (REQ-002)
Re-registration with the same name is an atomic replace; identical re-registration is a no-op (no event); unregister(unknown) is a no-op (no event); reset() clears all (no events) (REQ-003, ADR-077)
Empty/None free text = no free-text constraint; no free text + no filters = match all (REQ-005)
Text matching is case-insensitive (case-folded) + Unicode NFC + trimmed; number/boolean/datetime are exact (REQ-012)
Unknown feature in a query raises UnknownSourceError (a SearchError subclass, NOT ValueError) (REQ-010)
A None event_bus means no events and no error; a None settings_registry uses the shared registry; a None permission_service is standalone mode (REQ-014, REQ-016)
The registry is guarded by an internal lock — no partial state on concurrent register/query (REQ-018)
Query text, result content, and source data never appear in log records, events, or error messages (NFR-002)
completion_gates: Acceptance tests for AC-001, AC-002, AC-003, AC-004, AC-005, AC-007, AC-008, AC-023, AC-032 pass
Unit tests for EDGE-001, EDGE-013, EDGE-014, EDGE-016, EDGE-021 pass
Property test for INV-001 passes

tasks.title: search query semantics: filter DSL (per-type operators, AND/OR nesting), sorting (stable tie-break), pagination (default page size, cap clamp, offset), result shape (display fields), MalformedQueryError validation, normalization
implementation_steps: Extend the service's query path with the filter DSL: evaluate FilterCondition/FilterGroup (AND/OR, nestable) over the source's declared filterable fields; per-type operator restrictions (string: equals/contains/starts_with/in_list/is_null; number: equals/gt/gte/lt/lte/in_list/is_null; boolean: equals/in_list/is_null; datetime: equals/gt/gte/lt/lte/in_list/is_null); string matching is case-insensitive (REQ-006)

Implement sorting: a user sort on a declared-sortable field overrides the source's default ordering; ties are broken stably by the source's default ordering (the order the query function returns items when sort is None) (REQ-008)

Implement pagination: offset/limit; the default page size is the live search.default_page_size; limit > search.max_page_size is clamped to the cap (no error); the response carries the total match count; an offset beyond the last match = empty list, no error (REQ-007)

Implement the result shape: each result item = feature (source name) + item_id + the declared display field values (fields dict); page metadata (total, offset, limit); the caller renders directly (no round-trip to the source feature) (REQ-009)

Implement MalformedQueryError validation: invalid operator for a field's type, filter on a non-filterable field (or absent from the schema), sort on a non-sortable field, invalid value type, limit < 1, offset < 0 — each identifying the reason (and the field/source where applicable) (REQ-010)

Apply normalization consistently: the service normalizes the free text before fan-out; sources apply the same normalization (case-folded + NFC + trimmed) to their string values for free-text and string filter matching; number/boolean/datetime are exact (REQ-012)
A source with no searchable fields contributes 0 matches to a non-empty free-text query (no error) (EDGE-012)
design_constraints: Filters are restricted to fields the source declared filterable; per-type operator restrictions apply (REQ-006)
Sorting is deterministic only (no relevance score); a user sort overrides the source's default ordering; ties break stably by the source's default ordering (REQ-008)
The default page size is the live search.default_page_size; limit > search.max_page_size is clamped (no error); an offset beyond the last match = empty list, no error (REQ-007)
Each result item = feature + item_id + the declared display field values; the caller renders directly (REQ-009)
Malformed query cases raise MalformedQueryError identifying the reason (and field/source where applicable) — NOT ValueError (REQ-010)
Text matching is case-insensitive (case-folded) + Unicode NFC + trimmed; number/boolean/datetime are exact (REQ-012)
A source with no searchable fields contributes 0 matches to a non-empty free-text query (no error) (EDGE-012)
The query result is deterministic — the same input + the same source state yields the same items, order, and total (INV-002)

tasks.title: search fan-out + cross-cutting: global fan-out (combined pagination, strict validation), resilient per-source failure markers, per-source timeout (worker pool), events, feature settings (live read), tracing (@logged_class/@logged), permission enforcement (search.search)
implementation_steps: Implement the global fan-out: when feature is omitted, the query fans out to all registered sources; each source receives the same SourceQueryContext (same offset/limit); the combined page is the concatenation of the per-source pages in registration order; total is the sum of the per-source totals (REQ-004)

Implement strict fan-out validation: a global query is validated against every source in the fan-out — a filter on a field the source did not declare filterable (or absent from the schema), a sort on a non-sortable field, an operator invalid for the field's type, or a value of the wrong type -> MalformedQueryError (identifying the source + field) (REQ-010, EDGE-020)

Implement the resilient global fan-out: a source raising during a global search -> partial results + a per-source failure marker (SourceFailure: feature, reason query_failed/timeout, error kind); no exception is raised; the other sources' results are returned; a SourceQueryFailed event is published (REQ-011)
Implement the single-source failure: a source raising during a single-source query (feature set) -> SourceQueryFailedError (source + reason + error kind) (REQ-010)

Implement the per-source timeout: each source query runs in a worker thread (bounded pool); exceeding the live search.source_timeout (ms) -> a source failure with reason timeout (failure marker for global; SourceQueryFailedError for single-source); the timed-out thread is abandoned (bounded by the pool; its result is discarded) (REQ-019)

Create feature_settings.py with register_settings(registry) (traced with @logged): register search.default_page_size (NUMBER, default 100), search.max_page_size (NUMBER, default 1000), search.source_timeout (NUMBER, default 5000 ms); all are read live on each operation; unregistered keys fall back to the hardcoded defaults (REQ-013)

Publish the lifecycle/failure events: SourceRegistered (on register/replace), SourceUnregistered (on unregister), SourceQueryFailed (on a source failure) — NO per-query event; non-sensitive data only (no query text, no result content); a None publisher means no events and no error (REQ-014)

Trace SearchService with @logged_class(include_args=False, slow_threshold_ms=100) from the shared logging feature; trace the module functions (register_settings, register_actions, get_search_service, reset_search_service) with @logged; query text and result content never appear in log records (REQ-015)

Create feature_actions.py with register_actions(catalog) (traced with @logged): declare the search.search action (additive to the catalog; no change to the permissions feature's code or behavior) (REQ-016, ADR-079)

Enforce the permission at search entry: search takes a trailing principal: Principal = Principal() parameter and is enforced via the shared requires_permission("search.search") decorator (the injected PermissionChecker; standalone mode when None), before returning results; a denial raises and propagates before any source is queried (REQ-016, ADR-079)
Verify thread safety: the registry and the query path are safe for concurrent use; no partial state on concurrent register/query (a query sees either the old or the new registration) (REQ-018)
design_constraints: The combined page is the concatenation of the per-source pages in registration order; total is the sum of the per-source totals (REQ-004)
A global query is validated against every source in the fan-out (strict) — a field absent or non-filterable in any source -> MalformedQueryError (REQ-010, EDGE-020)
A source raising during a global search -> partial results + a failure marker; no exception; a SourceQueryFailed event is published (REQ-011)
A source raising during a single-source query -> SourceQueryFailedError (REQ-010)
Each source query runs in a worker thread (bounded pool); exceeding the live search.source_timeout -> reason timeout; the timed-out thread is abandoned (bounded by the pool) (REQ-019)
The settings are read live on each operation; unregistered keys fall back to the hardcoded defaults (REQ-013)
NO per-query event; events carry non-sensitive data only (no query text, no result content); a None publisher means no events and no error (REQ-014)
SearchService is traced with @logged_class(include_args=False, slow_threshold_ms=100); module functions traced with @logged; query text and result content never appear in log records (REQ-015)

search enforces search.search at entry via the shared Principal/PermissionChecker plumbing (trailing principal parameter; standalone mode when no checker); a denial raises before any source is queried (REQ-016, ADR-079)
The registry and the query path are thread-safe; no partial state on concurrent register/query (REQ-018)
For any operation output — results, events, error messages, log records — the query text, result content, and source data never appear (INV-005, NFR-002)

tasks.title: cross-cutting final: startup wiring (register_settings, register_actions, the three feature sources) + backend-only contract + NFRs (performance, secret-freedom, public API, observability, thread safety)
implementation_steps: Wire the startup path (application entrypoint, once): register_settings(get_settings_registry()) (search feature), register_actions(permission_catalog) (search feature, additive catalog action), search_service = get_search_service(event_bus=event_bus, permission_service=permission_service), then search_service.register_source(build_user_source(user_repository)), search_service.register_source(build_file_source(file_repository)), search_service.register_source(build_session_source(session_repository)) (REQ-023, D19)
Verify the backend-only contract: the search feature's public API is an in-process service only (no HTTP/REST surface, no frontend dependency); any in-process caller may use it (REQ-023, AC-037)

Create tests/contract/search/test_search_contracts.py with the NFR contract tests: test_nfr_001_performance_budgets (a single-source query < 100 ms median including @logged overhead; register_source < 5 ms median; 10k-100k items per source on local hardware against SQLite-backed sources with the shared logging feature at its default INFO level), test_nfr_002_no_query_or_results_in_logs_events (query text, result content, and source data never appear in log records, events, error messages, or result payloads beyond the declared display fields; permission checks are fail-closed), test_nfr_003_public_api_contract (the public API of backend.search allows breaking changes with a major version per the recorded deviation Q-124), test_nfr_004_traced_service_events (service methods traced via @logged_class include_args=False; source lifecycle and failure events published; no per-query events) (NFR-001..NFR-004)

Create the integration tests: test_nfr_005_thread_safe_registry (the registry and the query path are thread-safe; a source failure leaves no partial state; abandoned timeout threads are bounded by the worker pool; a failed operation leaves the registry unchanged) and test_startup_wiring_all_sources (the startup wiring registers all three feature sources and a global search fans out to them) (NFR-005, REQ-023)
